description: Shared platform code for the ElectroHire API and MCP Workers: mirrored content loading, tool logic, rate-limit/kill-switch guard, the C-15 prompt-injection defense layers, and the Phase C2 API-key authorization gate (scopes, binding, quotas, CUI provider policy). No content facts live here — content is mirrored from the website's generated /content/v1.json (C-01). Phase C3 adds OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE, RFC 9728/8414 metadata, RFC 8707 audience-bound tokens in the same gate) and the newsletter / support-ticket action tools with C-15 layers 3+4 real. Ellie actions are NOT built (Phase E gated).
name: @electrohire/platform
